Script to read in all tif files


```{r}
years <- seq(1950, 2099)
months <- sprintf("%02d", seq(1,12))
variables <- c("hurs","huss","pr","rlds","rsds","sfcWind", "tas","tasmax","tasmin")
times <- c("historical", "ssp585", "ssp245")
combos <- expand.grid(year = years, variable = variables, time = times)

midwest_states <- c(
  "Minnesota", "Wisconsin", "Iowa", "Illinois", "Indiana", "Michigan",
  "Ohio", "Missouri", "Kansas", "Nebraska", "North Dakota", "South Dakota"
)
states <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")
midwest_sf <- states[states$name %in% midwest_states, ]
midwest_sf_slim <- midwest_sf %>% select(name, geometry)
st_write(midwest_sf_slim, "website_data/midwest_states.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE)

url <- "/vsicurl/https://nex-gddp-cmip6-cog.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/monthly/CMIP6_ensemble_median/pr/pr_month_ensemble-median_ssp585_202001.tif"
r <- rast(url)
r_crop <- crop(r, midwest_vect)
r_mask <- mask(r_crop, midwest_vect)
summary(values(r_mask))

midwest_vect <- vect(midwest_sf)

clean_combos <- combos%>%
  filter(!(year < 2015 & time %in% c("ssp585", "ssp245")),
         !(year >2014 & time == "historical"),
         !(year == 2096 & variable == "tas"),
         !(year == 2093 & variable == "tasmin" & time == "ssp585"))%>%
  arrange(year)%>%
  arrange(variable)%>%
  arrange(time)

process_year <- function(var, scenario, yr, months, midwest_vect){
  
  midwest_vect <- unwrap(midwest_vect)
  out_file <- str_c("../../cmip6/data/", var, "/", var, "_", scenario, "_", yr, ".tif")
  if (file.exists(out_file)) return(out_file)
  
  rast_year <- vector("list", length = 12)
  
  for (mo in months){
    url <- str_c("/vsicurl/https://nex-gddp-cmip6-cog.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/monthly/CMIP6_ensemble_median/", var, "/", var, "_month_ensemble-median_", scenario, "_", yr, mo, ".tif")
    r <- rast(url)
    r_crop <- crop(r, midwest_vect)
    r_mask <- mask(r_crop, midwest_vect)
    
    # sec conversion removed — pr values from this product are already monthly mm totals
    
    rast_year[[as.numeric(mo)]] <- r_mask
  }
  
  year_stack <- rast(rast_year)
  agg_fun <- if (var == "pr") sum else mean
  annual <- app(year_stack, fun = agg_fun, na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(annual, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  out_file
}

midwest_wrapped <- wrap(midwest_vect)
results <- future_pmap(
  clean_combos%>%filter(variable == "pr"),
  function(variable, time, year) {
    process_year(
      var = variable,
      scenario = time,
      yr = year,
      months = months,
      midwest_vect = midwest_wrapped
    )
  },
  .options = furrr_options(packages = "terra"),
  .progress = TRUE
)
length(list.files("data/tasmin"))*9*16/1000

```

Converting GeoTiff to JSON

```{r}

convert_file <- function(tif_path, var_name, out_path){
  r <- rast(tif_path)
  df <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE)
  names(df) <- c("lon", "lat", "value")
  if (var_name %in% c("tasmin", "tasmax", "tas")){
    df <- df%>%
      mutate(value = (value - 273.15)*9/5 + 32)
  }
  else if (var_name == "sfcWind"){
    df <- df%>%
      mutate(value = value*2.237)
  }
  else if (var_name == "pr"){
    df <- df%>%
      mutate(value = value/25.4)
  }
  write_json(df%>%select(value), out_path)
}

tif_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

for (file in tif_files){
  var_name <- str_extract(file, "((?<=/).*)(?=/)")
  new_path <- str_c("data/website_data/", str_remove(file, "data/")%>%str_remove(".tif"), ".json")
  convert_file(file, var_name, new_path)
}

dat <- fromJSON("data/website_data/tasmin/tasmin_ssp585_2099.json")
```



```{r}
tif_files <- list.files("../../cmip6/data/pr", pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build ONE fixed spatial mask + cell order, from geometry alone —
#    not from any file's data — so every file is read out identically.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

template <- rast(tif_files[1])                       # any file works: same grid throughout
midwest_mask_r <- rasterize(midwest_vect, template)   # purely geometric, same every year
in_midwest <- !is.na(values(midwest_mask_r)[, 1])     # fixed-length logical vector

xy_all <- xyFromCell(template, 1:ncell(template))
lon_lat <- as.data.frame(xy_all[in_midwest, ])
names(lon_lat) <- c("lon", "lat")

# dir.create("data/website_data", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# write_json(lon_lat, "data/website_data/lat_long.json", digits = 4)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Parse variable/scenario/year from filenames, and verify every
#    file actually shares the template's grid before trusting position.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

parse_tif_meta <- function(path) {
  file_noext <- str_remove(basename(path), "\\.tif$")
  parts <- str_split(file_noext, "_")[[1]]
  n <- length(parts)
  tibble(
    variable = str_c(parts[1:(n - 2)], collapse = "_"),
    scenario = parts[n - 1],
    year     = as.numeric(parts[n]),
    path     = path
  )
}

meta <- bind_rows(lapply(tif_files, parse_tif_meta))

geometry_ok <- sapply(meta$path, function(p) compareGeom(rast(p), template, stopOnError = FALSE))
if (!all(geometry_ok)) {
  stop("Geometry mismatch in: ", paste(meta$path[!geometry_ok], collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Unit conversions (same as your version, kept as-is)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

convert_units <- function(vals, var_name) {
  if (var_name %in% c("tasmin", "tasmax", "tas")) {
    (vals - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32          # K -> F
  } else if (var_name == "sfcWind") {
    vals * 2.237                        # m/s -> mph
  } else if (var_name == "pr") {
    vals / 25.4                         # mm -> inches
  } else {
    vals
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build the 27 aggregated files: one per variable+scenario,
#    each { years: [...], values: [[...], [...], ...] }.
#    Every year is pulled through the SAME in_midwest mask, so
#    position i is always the same grid cell, everywhere.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

grouped_list <- meta %>% arrange(variable, scenario, year) %>% group_split(variable, scenario)

for (g in grouped_list) {
  var_name <- g$variable[1]
  scenario_name <- g$scenario[1]

  values_by_year <- lapply(g$path, function(p) {
    r <- rast(p)
    vals <- values(r)[, 1][in_midwest]     # same length/order every year, guaranteed
    vals <- convert_units(vals, var_name)
    round(vals, 3)
  })

  out <- list(years = g$year, values = values_by_year)
  out_path <- str_c("website_data/", var_name, "_", scenario_name, ".json")
  write_json(out, out_path, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
}
```
